The Countdown Has Begun — Unlock the Future!

You hold the key to unlock The New Group’s future at The Theater at St. Clement’s. Your critical support opens our doors to risk-taking artistry and new possibilities. Thanks to the generosity of an anonymous donor, every gift will be matched dollar for dollar up to $100,000 from Giving Tuesday through December 31, 2025. Turn the key to double your donation.
